claims.text: On the nineteenth of February, Mars is opposite the Sun.
A hundred and one million kilometres is the gap at opposition.
Mars ranges from about fifty-six million kilometres at its closest, back in 2003, to four hundred and one million at its farthest.

Mars reaches opposition on 19 February 2027: opposite the Sun, up all night, and 101 million km from Earth. Opposition happens because Earth, on the inside track, laps Mars. For scale, Mars ranges from about 55.8 million km at its closest (2003) to about 401 million km at its farthest.
